description:
You are logged into wger fitness manager at http://localhost as admin (username: admin, password: adminadmin). You are the athletic trainer for the Westbrook University basketball team. Set up the complete off-season strength and conditioning program.

Create these three training phase routines with their respective training days:

1. Routine: "Phase 1 - Anatomical Adaptation"
   Description: "Weeks 1-4: Movement quality and work capacity foundation"
   Training Days:
   - "Upper Body Foundations" (Day of Week: Monday)
   - "Lower Body Foundations" (Day of Week: Thursday)

2. Routine: "Phase 2 - Maximal Strength"
   Description: "Weeks 5-8: Heavy compound lifts for peak force production"
   Training Days:
   - "Heavy Upper" (Day of Week: Tuesday)
   - "Heavy Lower" (Day of Week: Friday)

3. Routine: "Phase 3 - Power Development"
   Description: "Weeks 9-12: Explosive movements and sport-specific power"
   Training Days:
   - "Explosive Upper" (Day of Week: Monday)
   - "Explosive Lower" (Day of Week: Wednesday)

All routine names, descriptions, day names, and day-of-week assignments must be exact.
